subject_definitions:
  <Wednesday> The selected reference character, faithfully matching the provided reference image. Preserve her recognizable facial identity, pale complexion, dark eyes, long black hair in two neat braids, center parting, and signature gothic appearance. She wears her iconic black dress with a white pointed collar, maintaining consistent clothing, hairstyle, facial features, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout the video. Her expression is naturally serious, emotionless, and subtly intimidating, with dry, dark humor.

integrated_multimodal_description:
  Live-action photorealistic 10-second footage of Wednesday Addams at home on a dark, gothic-style couch. Moody cinematic lighting with soft shadows, faint purple and candle-like accents, black furniture, deep shadows, and a shallow depth of field. Wednesday sits perfectly upright on the couch, one arm resting along the back, the other in her lap. Her long black braids hang neatly over her shoulders. Her expression remains almost completely emotionless, with occasional slow blinks, subtle eyebrow movements, and minimal head gestures. Ultra-realistic skin texture, detailed black fabric, natural eye movements, subtle film grain, cinematic color grading, and a slow, gentle camera push-in.
  [0-3s] Medium close-up. Wednesday sits motionless on the couch, staring directly into the camera with an unsettlingly blank expression. She leans forward slightly and says with precise lip sync, in a calm, low, dry voice: "You goons need to touch some fucking grass." She pauses briefly, maintaining unbroken eye contact with the camera.
  [3-7s] Wednesday lightly taps one black-painted fingernail against the couch arm. Without smiling, she holds the silence, then slowly tilts her head and raises one eyebrow, giving the camera a cold, analytical stare as though the statement should be painfully obvious. Her delivery remains completely deadpan, with impeccable comedic timing.
  [7-10s] She leans a fraction closer and holds a perfectly straight face for a beat, then gives the faintest hint of a sinister smirk before returning to her original expression. She ends by staring directly into the lens without blinking as the camera finishes its slow push-in.
  Maintain strict character consistency throughout the entire clip. Wednesday must retain her recognizable facial identity, pale skin, black braided hair, gothic black dress, white collar, and natural human anatomy. Keep her movements restrained, deliberate, and controlled. Her humor must come entirely from dry sarcasm, precise delivery, and unsettling pauses. No exaggerated expressions, no broad smiles, no random gestures, no character morphing, and no changes to her clothing or hairstyle. Accurate synchronized lip movements for every spoken line.

overall_soundscape:
  Intimate close-mic dialogue with a slightly dark, domestic quality. Subtle fingernail taps against the couch fabric/arm, faint clothing rustle, and quiet atmospheric room tone. Her voice is calm, articulate, low-pitched, and completely deadpan, with deliberate pauses for comedic effect.

non_diegetic_music:
  Very quiet, eerie gothic instrumental music featuring sparse piano notes, subtle cello, and a faint atmospheric drone. Keep the music well below the dialogue. Add a brief, ominous piano note at the final stare. No vocals, no dramatic musical crescendo.
